# Bundled browser libraries

- Chart.js 4.4.0: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js — MIT, see chart.LICENSE.md.
- jsPDF 2.5.1: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js — MIT, see jspdf.LICENSE.

Files are kept local so predictions, charts and English PDF export do not require a CDN. System fonts are used; the unused Lucide dependency was removed. External links and WhatsApp sharing still require connectivity.
